title: I have nothing final yet should post capsule and in engine stills to my Steam page?
author: Square_Reason_6490
selftext:
Working on my first steam release and wondering

if it makes sense to post some capsule art and in

engine stills now and update when I'm rdy. to

show in game gameplay. Do I just write out the

gameplay and premise? Or is this all a waste until

I have gameplay footage? Just want to make sure

I'm not shooting myself in the foot

comments.author: SillyYou8433
comments.body:
If you have at least gameplay down, its never a bad idea to start marketing. Post your concept online (reddit, instagram, youtube, tik tok) and start trying to get attention from it. This can reinforce if what you're building will click with any audience. Personally this is too early to start a Steam page, but I could be wrong.

But your next step is definitely to try and start getting some art down. At least a basic player character, maybe some environment assets. The rest of what to prioritize depends on the game genre

comments.author: Square_Reason_6490
comments.body: I’m at the stage where I have the game world (story/vibe) figured out core game play loop, game art direction needs work the game is all grey box for the most part. I want to start working on the branding in the background I would make multiple passes on the storefront I asked because we live in the “show the world as you make” era so I had to ask

replies.author: Jolva
replies.body: I'm not sure how engine stills with no art in the game are going to be helpful but I have no idea how your game works. Something interesting and mysterious is one thing, but if it leans more into "how the sausage is made" you might want to wait.

replies.author: Square_Reason_6490
replies.body: Oh sorry the engine stills are what the game looks in game screenshots but from the engine because the game isn’t finished I thought I would just call it wip or concept art but if I put something on my page in a few days it would be capsule are, 3-4 game shots this show art style and concept
